scope: Corollary 3.2 (Absolute perturbation bound) of the manuscript “A radial continuum phase transition with algebraic decay” (preprints/A-radial-continuum-phase-transition-with-algebraic-decay-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d53cafa68c322a07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In a fixed bounded region, let vθ = (1 − θ)v0 + θv1, 0 ≤ θ ≤ 1, be bounded symmetric pair interactions satisfying the hypotheses of Proposition 3.1 with the same t and M. Let Jdiff be a symmetric nonnegative matrix such that |v1(x, y) − v0(x, y)| ≤ Jdiff ij (x ∈ Ci, y ∈ Cj). Then, uniformly for (β, h) ∈ D, |log Ξv1 (β, h) − log Ξv0 (β, h)| ≤ βC1 2 X i,j Jdiff ij . (3.5) Thus signed deletions are controlled by the absolute interaction difference, with no cancellation assumption.
